description: Deterministic acquisition and integrity gates for private Instagram message imports.

cases.criterion: Every configured Instagram profile exposes the same messages-only Google Drive protocol: one all-time baseline followed by all-time-lookback daily exports for three years, with an account-specific packet prefix.
The single hourly scheduler reads the live account registry instead of embedding a stale or private account list in its launch command.
Operators can list configured Instagram profiles and body-free health state without reading or emitting private message content.
Full-history coverage is an account-specific assertion backed by a locally completed baseline packet and cannot leak from one Instagram profile to another.
A missing or pending account cannot erase the last complete multi-account Instagram projection, and its state remains observable per account and in aggregate.
When every configured account has a usable source, one sync atomically rebuilds distinct account-scoped threads, preserves separate person and organization owners, and renders account entry points.
An account-specific authenticated pull uses that account's exact packet prefix and private cache, completion registry, and manifest paths.
A shared Drive container selects only folders matching the configured Instagram account's exact export prefix, excluding other profiles and lookalike names.
A legacy primary Instagram pipeline can be adopted in place while a second account receives isolated cache, registry, mirror, and status paths with shared read-only Drive credentials.
Identical provider thread paths exported by different Instagram accounts remain distinct canonical threads and retain both message histories.
A legitimate Instagram export packet with no message files is recorded and skipped without degrading completed message history or being retraversed forever.
A delivered HTML packet previously classified as having no supported message files is reconsidered when that provider format becomes importable.
Wide provider message skeletons are enumerated with bounded sibling concurrency instead of one network round trip at a time.
A stable container with many dated Meta folders discovers Instagram export packets with bounded sibling concurrency.
A historical Drive transfer that outlives its initial access token refreshes credentials during traversal instead of degrading after partial progress.
Google authorization remains refreshable for unattended checks, protected by PKCE and state, and limited to the read-only Drive scope.
A configured read-only Drive API pull overrides an explicit Drive Desktop path that has not materialized message files.
A stable Drive container accumulates every Instagram export packet while refusing unrelated Drive trees.
Message mirroring downloads only Instagram message subtrees and excludes unrelated account-export sections.
Scheduled Meta delta exports compose into one cumulative local message history instead of replacing earlier packets.
Freshness and completeness remain separate: incremental packets cannot be called full history until a verified all-time baseline is recorded.
A completed authenticated pull atomically advances the stable local Instagram mirror and records observable freshness state.
The cumulative completed provider set replaces stale bootstrap custody rows without duplicating sources, threads, or messages.
A failed or partial provider pull cannot replace the last completed local Instagram mirror.
The Instagram-only macOS LaunchAgent checks hourly and at login without pinning an online-only Drive Desktop path.
Manual and scheduled Instagram sync runs cannot overlap and race on the same private cache files.
The scheduler cannot be installed against a removable-volume workspace that macOS background privacy will deny.
macOS Spotlight results cannot split one exact export snapshot into duplicate nested import roots.
The same logical message remains one canonical row when overlapping exports change file pagination or array order.
A previously verified private cache remains usable when the provider pull is temporarily unavailable.
Instagram messages, participants, groups, media references, transcripts, and person capsules render from canonical state.
Meta's downloadable HTML message pages become canonical account-scoped threads and messages instead of being mistaken for empty packets.
Repository-owned eval and script entries remain compatible with Localgraph workspace validation.
